senses.sense_definition: To perform a surgical lobotomy on someone.

examples.text: Mid-century doctors attempted to <w>lobotomize</w> patients as a radical treatment for psychiatric disorders.
The surgeon chose not to <w>lobotomize</w> the individual after considering less invasive therapies.

senses.sense_definition: To deprive someone or something of energy, vitality, personality, or intelligence.

examples.text: Critics complained that aggressive corporate editing would effectively <w>lobotomize</w> the original film.
Spending all day doing repetitive data entry threatened to <w>lobotomize</w> his creative spirit.
